browser_tests: Reporting refresh, future-date rejection, wallet-failure isolation, country selectors and responsive layouts passed; checkout and settings regressions passed
database_tests: Actual Supabase sandbox with signed controlled carrier events; all fixture writes rolled back. Date-scoped lanes and tracking coverage passed; a known two-day observed transit interval was verified.
calculation: Current shipment outcomes for bookings in the selected UTC period. Average observed transit = mean((delivery time - first accepted in-transit update)/86400), excluding missing or inconsistent timestamps. Lane price = average recorded customer shipping price within each origin/destination/currency group.
warehouse_efficiency: Removed misleading label; carrier APIs do not measure warehouse staff productivity. Card now displays Shipping lane costs.
integration_boundary: Uses existing authenticated provider tracking ingestion. This test does not claim genuine provider-console webhook delivery; real transit data requires configured tracking webhooks and confirmed shipments.
